delivery.title: Delivery: fast, convenient and affordable
delivery.intro: At Marco Group, we make sure that receiving your order is just as convenient as shopping.
points: Your order will be delivered to the address you specify within 1–3 business days.
Delivery is free within a distance of 20 km.
Each additional kilometer beyond 20 km costs 150 AMD.

returnPolicy.title: Return Policy
returnPolicy.intro: To be eligible for a return, please make sure that:
points: The item is undamaged by the buyer, in its original condition, and in the original packaging.
The return request is submitted within 14 days of purchase, unless otherwise specified.
Proof of purchase is provided (order number or receipt).
Final sale or non-returnable items cannot be returned.

howToReturn.title: How to start a return
steps: Contact our support team with your order number and return request.
Receive instructions on the return terms.
Return the item including all details provided at the time of purchase, the warranty slip, and the tags.
After we receive and inspect the item, we will confirm approval or rejection of the refund.

refund.title: Refund method and timing
points: Approved refunds are issued to the original payment method.
Processing time is usually 3–5 business days after approval; bank times may vary.
Shipping fees are not refunded, except when the return is due to our error or a defective item.

nonRefundable.title: Non-refundable items
points: Personalized or custom-made items, except defective items.
Items that are not in original condition, are damaged, or have missing parts, unless this is due to our error.
